description: This PHP file defines the DocumentRevision class, which represents and manages document revision entities within the SuiteCRM (a SugarCRM-based) system. It includes properties for document metadata, methods for saving, retrieving, and formatting revision data, and static methods for related database operations.

classes.name: DocumentRevision
classes.description: Represents a document revision, with properties and methods to handle document revision data within the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the DocumentRevision class, setting up custom fields and security.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the document revision data to the database and updates related documents.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the filename as a summary representation of the revision.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a document revision record by ID from the database.

methods.name: is_authenticated
methods.description: Checks if the current document revision is authenticated.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Fills in additional fields for list views.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional detail fields such as document name and latest revision info.

methods.name: getDocumentRevisionNameForDisplay
methods.description: Generates a display filename for the revision, considering revision number and file extension.

methods.name: fill_document_name_revision
methods.description: Populates document name and latest revision data from database.

methods.name: list_view_parse_additional_sections
methods.description: Parses additional sections for list view (stub implementation).

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Returns an array of data for list view, including file URL.

methods.name: get_document_revision_name
methods.description: Static method to fetch the revision string for a given revision ID.

methods.name: get_document_revisions
methods.description: Static method to retrieve all revisions for a document ID.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates if the bean implements certain interfaces such as 'FILE'.
